verdict.rationale: Devin's docs show a cloud agent that implements entire features in its own VM with a shell and browser. It can build and test apps across platforms, and Auto-Fix iterates on review comments and CI failures until the PR is merge-ready. The 'demo for my review' part is only implied by computer-use screenshots and PR review flows, and community reports of extraneous changes lower confidence. missing for 10: an explicitly documented demo or walkthrough artifact (e.g., recorded video or test evidence) delivered for review, and independent hands-on corroboration of the full build-test-demo loop.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review

citations.quote: The cloud session gets its own VM with a shell, browser, and full repo access, so it can keep going after you close your laptop.
It can move the mouse, click on UI elements, type on the keyboard, take screenshots
Devin can now build and test iOS and macOS applications.
Devin automatically responds to code review comments, fixes flagged bugs, and iterates on CI failures
